messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

We need to compute speed after first 10 seconds given distance 120 m, starting from rest, constant acceleration? It says "汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離" implies constant acceleration? Usually yes. So we can compute acceleration a = 2s / t^2? Actually distance s = 0.5 a t^2 => a = 2s / t^2 = 2*120 / 100 = 240/100 = 2.4 m/s^2. Final speed v = a t = 2.4*10 = 24 m/s. So first part speed = 24 m/s.

Second part: "汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？" Wait: It says "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" but initial speed? Might refer to initial speed of second stage? It says "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" maybe meaning starting at 12 m/s and ending at twice that (24 m/s). But earlier we found first part speed 24 m/s. So second stage initial speed 12 m/s? But also says final speed is double the speed from first part? Wait first part speed is 24 m/s. Double that would be 48 m/s. So maybe they mean final speed is double the speed from first part? Let's read: "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" means final speed is twice the speed computed in first part. That would be 48 m/s. But earlier they said "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" which would be 24 m/s.
